tools.name: jubelio_list_products
tools.description: List products (items) with their code, name, category, prices and status. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /inventory/items/.

tools.name: jubelio_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its id, with variations, prices and stock settings. Jubelio API: GET /inventory/items/{id}.

tools.name: jubelio_get_product_by_sku
tools.description: Get one product by its item code (SKU), exactly as it is stored in Jubelio. Jubelio API: GET /inventory/items/by-sku/{sku}.

tools.name: jubelio_list_stock
tools.description: List the stock of each product, with quantities by location and by sales channel. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /inventory/.

tools.name: jubelio_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders in one state: completed, cancelled, failed or returned. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /sales/orders/completed/, /cancel/, /failed/ or /returned-list/.

tools.name: jubelio_get_sales_order
tools.description: Get one sales order by its id: customer, items, totals, channel status and cancel reason. Jubelio API: GET /sales/orders/{id}.

tools.name: jubelio_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with their number, customer, totals and payment state. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /sales/invoices/.

tools.name: jubelio_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one sales invoice by its id, with its lines and payments. Jubelio API: GET /sales/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: jubelio_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts: customers, vendors, or both. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /contacts/.

tools.name: jubelio_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its id, with its addresses, tax and payment terms. Jubelio API: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: jubelio_save_contact
tools.description: Create a customer, vendor or both (contact_id 0, the default), or edit one (its contact_id). This writes to the Jubelio account. An edit may clear fields you leave out, so read the contact with jubelio_get_contact first. Jubelio API: POST /contacts/.

tools.name: jubelio_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders with their number, supplier, totals and receive state. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /purchase/orders/.

tools.name: jubelio_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by its id, with its items and totals. Jubelio API: GET /purchase/orders/{id}.

tools.name: jubelio_list_locations
tools.description: List the warehouse and store locations of the account. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /locations/.

tools.name: jubelio_list_stores
tools.description: List the marketplace and online stores connected to the account. Filter with a free-text query. Jubelio API: GET /marketplace/store/.

tools.name: jubelio_list_couriers
tools.description: List the shipping couriers set up for the account. Jubelio API: GET /couriers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jubelio_save_contact · Private data: jubelio_list_contacts, jubelio_get_contact, jubelio_save_contact · Public sink: jubelio_save_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jubelio_save_contact · Private data: jubelio_list_contacts, jubelio_get_contact, jubelio_save_contact · Public sink: jubelio_save_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
